scientific_integrity: One theorem with explicit all-parameter density jumps and an analytic reconstruction proof. Exact symbolic rational tests and randomized checks are supporting evidence, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only intrinsic three-path theta networks with strictly positive lengths and normalized arclength sampling.
Exact population distance distribution is required; no statistical stability claim.
Historical-priority review is provisional, and independent validation was not performed.
title: Global distance-histogram rigidity of three-path metric theta graphs
